interpretation.derivation: The author supplies an explicitly complete five-race table and says only Desperate Prayer is shared. Fear Ward is assigned only to Dwarf. This supports the racial restriction in addition to the existing positive Dwarf quest, rather than inferring exclusivity from that one quest.

limits: Guide availability is not proof a captured player completed the quest, knew the spell, had its cooldown, was assigned a duty or had a usable opportunity.
No additional spell IDs, healer loadout target, observed cast, racial absence or personal grade is inferred.
